title: Robey’s Atlas source and profile data
description: Human-annotated links, not full source texts. Missing information is unknown, not a negative finding.

identifiers.sourceKey: Deterministic SHA-256 digest prefix of the exact source URL; record identity, not a claim that editions/mirrors are different works.
identifiers.profileSlug: Directory access-point route, which may be an alias or broader label rather than a distinct nation.

fieldGuide.entryStage: name-only-outline means a separately findable queued entry with zero reading-source cards, zero substantive works and no completed history.
fieldGuide.identificationEvidence: Name/location verification provenance only. These records are separate from reading sources and do not establish historical coverage, legal status, territorial boundaries or endorsement.
fieldGuide.existingNameAliases: Verified longer or alternate government names can be searchable on an already represented community rather than duplicate its card.
fieldGuide.profileContexts: Every profile-specific source occurrence: local citation anchor, annotation, review/access scope and counting flags. Shared URLs can have different inspection limits.
fieldGuide.contentReviewedAt: Date of the recorded review; scope may be a selected excerpt, metadata/identity check or supporting record. Read the scope and status.
fieldGuide.accessed: Recorded access date, not proof of content review or current availability.
fieldGuide.accessNotes: Reported access conditions and inspection limits. A failed automated request is not proof of a reader paywall.
fieldGuide.countsTowardMinimum: False excludes a supporting or identity record. Absence is a legacy quantity convention, not proof of adequacy or full-work inspection.
fieldGuide.quantityRule: Recorded substantive quantity uses contentReviewedAt and countsTowardMinimum !== false; completeness, initialAdequacy and community review are separate.
fieldGuide.perspectives: Navigation groups derived from the recorded source type; mixed types can appear in several groups. Original type/annotation remain authoritative for scope.
fieldGuide.reuse: Original works and images keep their individual terms. No blanket source-text/image permission is granted by this catalogue.
